brand_identity.description: A contemporary Indian fashion/streetwear brand ecommerce site. Premium fashion label first, ecommerce second.
brand_identity.philosophy: Clean editorial discipline of H&M, premium visual storytelling of BLUORNG, strong merchandising of Bonkers Corner, with Nalayak's rebellious, witty Indian youth identity. 'Luxury fashion website with an attitude problem.'
brand_identity.tone: Humour via copywriting only, visuals stay premium.

typography.display_font: Cabinet Grotesk, Syne, or Clash Display (Refined grotesk display)
typography.body_font: Inter, Helvetica Neue, or Switzer (Clean sans body)

hierarchy.hero: text-6xl to text-8xl, tracking-tighter, uppercase, tight leading (leading-[0.85]).

rules: Never center default text block, use strong left or right alignment to build tension.
Typography drives the layout. Use large oversized wordmarks.
FORBIDDEN: gradients, glassmorphism, bright saturated accents (unless purely functional like a sale tag).

layouts_and_spacing.spacing: Generous whitespace. Use Tailwind p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32.
layouts_and_spacing.border_radius: Strictly 0px (rounded-none). No excessive rounded containers. Sharp, tailored aesthetic.
layouts_and_spacing.grid: Bento grids with uneven column spans (e.g., 8-col grid where items span 5 and 3) for asymmetrical tension.
layouts_and_spacing.components: No SaaS cards. Avoid shadow-sm or ring. Rely on 1px solid lines (border-black) and negative space.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY. Standard browser scroll feels cheap.
motion_and_interactions.hero_animation: Large kinetic hero with masked line-by-line reveal on load using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: One slow editorial marquee with refined typography.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Framer-motion scroll reveals (fade-up and clip-path). Image scaling on hover (subtle scale-105 with overflow-hidden).

homepage.announcement_bar: Sticky, thin, black background, white text.
homepage.navigation: Sticky, transparent to solid blur-free background, minimal links.
homepage.hero: Editorial hero 'NOT FOR EVERYONE'. Kinetic masked text reveal. Parallax background image.
homepage.new_arrivals: Product grid. Spotlit product photography, clipped frames (1px borders).
homepage.manifesto: Numbered manifesto chapters (e.g., '01.', '02.') with large typography and witty copy.
homepage.editorial_collections: 'THE NALAYAK EDIT'. Asymmetrical masonry or split grid.
homepage.campaign: 'WELCOME TO THE WRONG CROWD'. Dramatic dark section, inverted colors.
homepage.newsletter: 'DON'T BE NORMAL'. Minimalist input field, strong solid button.
homepage.footer: Full ecommerce footer with massive brand wordmark.

other_pages.plp: Product listing pages with minimal filters, sharp dropdowns.
other_pages.pdp: Product detail pages. Immersive gallery, sticky cart actions on the right.
other_pages.cart_drawer: Persistent cart drawer sliding from the right. Sharp edges, black and white.
other_pages.search: Full-screen search overlay with large input text.

media.data_management: Curated premium fashion/streetwear stock photos, all managed from one central data file (e.g., `src/data/storeData.js`).

accessibility: High contrast ratios for all text.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="cart-drawer-button"`).
Ensure hover states have higher contrast.
instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic AI aesthetic. Read the 'brand_identity' carefully.
No HTML/Tailwind standard cards or SaaS aesthetic. No rounded corners (rounded-none).
Build a central mock data file (`.js`) for all products, categories, and manifesto texts.
Install and configure Lenis, Framer Motion, and React Fast Marquee.
Apply `data-testid` to EVERY button, link, and form input.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements and stark contrast, NEVER through soft shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Use modern, sharp button styles (rounded-none). NEVER pill-shaped.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui but aggressively restyle them to remove borders, shadows, and radii.
